audio_description:
Blue magical energy gathers around Edea before the golden web.
She raises her hand and conjures an enormous shard of jagged ice.
She hurls the shard forward.
The glowing teal ice spike pierces toward Squall in profile.

context.scene_title: End of Disc 1 cliffhanger — Sorceress Edea conjures a giant ice shard and impales Squall during the failed assassination at the Deling City parade.
locations: Deling City — atop the parade gate dais, before Edea's golden radial-web backdrop, braziers burning

characters.name: Sorceress Edea
characters.recognition: Standing before the golden sunburst web, wreathed in blue magical energy; raises her arm to summon a large crystalline ice projectile.

characters.name: Squall Leonhart
characters.recognition: Brown-haired young man with the vertical scar and fur-collared jacket, shown in profile as the glowing teal ice shard drives toward/through him.

context.summary: Blue magical energy gathers around Edea as she stands before the gate's golden web. She raises her hand and conjures an enormous shard of jagged ice, then hurls it: the final shot shows the glowing teal spike piercing toward Squall's chest in profile — the dramatic cliffhanger that ends Disc 1.
context.context_note: High confidence: the iconic end-of-Disc-1 FMV where Edea's ice shard impales Squall.
